name: Nothing and Everything
source:
Sebastian and Callion have known each other for a while now. They've spent a number of nights together binging shows, watching movies, or just talking about life. Their bond is unmistakable, but recently it felt like the air was changing. 

...Or maybe Sebastian has only just noticed it. 

[from [url=https://fuzzytrashbird.itch.io/nothing-and-everything]itch.io[/url]]
